findings.finding: /saved page auth gating matches the existing /post page pattern exactly (useIsAuthenticated + AuthModal + redirect to '/' on close if still unauthenticated), rather than inventing a new pattern.
GET /users/me/saved is correctly scoped to req.user!.id via the (userId, listingId) compound key on every query; no cross-user read/write path exists.
findings.evidence: rentals/backend/src/routes/users.ts:100 where: { userId: req.user!.id, ... }; POST /listings/:id/save at listings.ts:287-306 also scopes findUnique/delete/create to req.user!.id.

findings.finding: Integrated GET /users/me/saved now filters out non-ACTIVE listings (stricter than a 'not REMOVED' check, matching GET /listings convention), flattens amenities to string[], sets isSaved:true, includes thumbnailUrl and the listing owner's safe user fields — response shape now matches GET /listings/GET /listings/:id exactly, so ListingCard and ListingDetail render identically regardless of source endpoint.
Duplicate-save race is backstopped by the @@unique([userId, listingId]) DB constraint on SavedListing; toggle logic (findUnique then create/delete) is correct and unchanged.

Unsaving a listing from /saved correctly removes it from the visible list via the onSaveChange callback threaded through ListingCard (optional prop, non-breaking for other ListingCard call sites like /browse and /map).

Loading (skeleton grid), empty (Heart icon + CTA to /browse), and error (retry button) states are all present and distinct, using the same grid layout/classes as /browse (grid sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-3 gap-5).
